paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Samuel a-upata a, Israel mite tung a vaihawmmi in atapate abawl hi.
heading: Mipite'n Kumpipa Angen Uh

paite: Ata masapen min Joel ahi a, azom min Abijah ahi. Amaute Beer-sheba a vaihawmte ahi uh.
Himahleh atapate'n ama omdan ala kei ua, sum-le-pai adelh ua, golhna ala ua, dik a vaihawmna akaikawi uhi.
Huchi in Israel mite upate tengteng akikhawm ua, Ramah ah Samuel kiang ah ahoh uhi.
Akiang ah, "Ngai in, na upa mahmahta a, na tapate'n lah na omdan ala kei hial uh. Namdang tengteng bang a ka tung ua vaihawm ding kumpipa hon bawlsak in," achi uhi.
Himahleh akiang a, "Ka tung ua vaihawm ding kumpipa hon pia in," achih un Samuel akipaksak kei hi. Huchi in TOUPA kiang ah Samuel athum hi,
TOUPA'N Samuel kiang ah, "Mite'n na kiang a agen tengteng uh ngaikhia in. Nang hon deih lou ahi kei ua, atung ua kumpipa dia kei hon deih lou ahi zaw uhi.
Aigupta gam a pan ka pikhiak ni a pan tutan a athilhihdan tengteng uh, hon lehngatsan a pathian dangte nna ahon sepsan zel uh mah bang in nang tung ah ahih uhi.
Huaiziak in athu uh ngaikhia in. Himahleh chitaktak in vauhilh inla, atung ua vaihawmmi kumpipa tatdan ding kawkmuh in," achi hi.
Samuel in TOUPA thu tengteng kumpipa ngen mipite ahilh vek hi.

"Na tung ua vaihawmmi ding kumpipa tatdan hichibang ahi ding. Na tapate uh ala dia, amah mah a ding, sakol kangtalai a ding leh asakol tungtuang mite ding in asep ding. Akhente asakol kangtalai ma ah atai ding uh.
Asepaih sangkhatte heutu ding leh sawmngate heutu ding asep dia; khenkhatte alei let ding, abuh la ding, agalvante bawl ding, akangtalai van bawl ding in azang ding hi.
Na tanute uh gimlim bawl ding, anhuan ding leh tanghou bawl ding in azang ding hi.
Na lou, na grephuan, olive huan a ahoih tata ahon sut dia, asikhate ape ding hi.
Na haichi leh na grephuan a sawm-a-khat ahon laksak dia; asikhate leh heutute ape ding hi.
Na sikhapate, na sikhanute, na tangval hoihhoihte leh na bawngte ahon sut dia, anasem ding in azang ding.
Na belamhon lak a sawm-a-khat ahon laksak dia; nou asikhate na hi ding uh.
Huai hun chiang in na tel ding uh kumpipa ziak in na kapkhe ding uh. Himahleh huai hun chiang in TOUPA'N ahon ngaikhe kei ding," achi hi.
Himahleh mipite'n Samuel thu azui nuam kei uh, "Ahi kei, kumpipa i neih ngeingei ding uh ahi.
Huchi in namdang tengteng bang i hong hi dia, i kumpipa'n vai ahon hawmsak dia, i namte pi in galte ahon doupih ding," achi uhi.
Samuel in mipite thugen tengteng aza a, TOUPA bil ah agensawn hi.
TOUPA'N Samuel kiang ah, "Athu uh la inla, kumpipa bawlsak in," achi hi. Samuel in Israel mite kiang ah, "Michih noumau khua chiat ah paita un," achi hi.
